import pytest

from bubble_sort import bubbleSort, bubble_sort
from bubble_sort.cli import main, parse_values, sorted_values
from sort import bubbleSort as legacy_bubbleSort
from sort import bubble_sort as legacy_bubble_sort


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("values", "expected"),
    [
        ([], []),
        ([1], [1]),
        ([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3]),
        ([3, 2, 1], [1, 2, 3]),
        ([64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90], [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]),
        ([3, -1, 3, 0], [-1, 0, 3, 3]),
        (["pear", "apple", "banana"], ["apple", "banana", "pear"]),
    ],
)
def test_bubble_sort_sorts_values_in_place(values, expected) -> None:
    result = bubble_sort(values)

    assert values == expected
    assert result is None


def test_bubble_sort_compatibility_wrapper() -> None:
    values = [3, 1, 2]

    result = bubbleSort(values)

    assert result is None
    assert values == [1, 2, 3]


def test_sort_module_re_exports_public_api() -> None:
    assert legacy_bubble_sort is bubble_sort
    assert legacy_bubbleSort is bubbleSort


def test_parse_values_uses_demo_values_when_no_arguments() -> None:
    assert parse_values(()) == [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]


def test_parse_values_keeps_text_arguments() -> None:
    assert parse_values(("pear", "apple", "banana")) == ["pear", "apple", "banana"]


def test_sorted_values_sorts_cli_arguments() -> None:
    assert sorted_values(("5", "1", "3")) == [1, 3, 5]


def test_sorted_values_sorts_text_arguments() -> None:
    assert sorted_values(("pear", "apple", "banana")) == ["apple", "banana", "pear"]


def test_cli_main_prints_sorted_demo_values(capsys) -> None:
    main(())

    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]\n"
